description: I want to remind you of my first re-election campaign kick-off with Congresswoman Jan Schakowsky, Congressman Mike Quigley, and Senate President Don Harmon on Sunday, January 16th from 3:00 p.m. to 4:30 p.m. The event will be taking place at the Holiday Inn Skokie (5300 W Touhy Ave). Please see below for the official invitation. Space is limited. Please click HERE to reserve your ticket(s). Please email Joey Slater at joeys@ramforsenate.com with any questions.
